---
title: "Resume and rebuild"
---

## Resume

If the installation fails, fix the cause and run the same command again in the
same directory. Finished packages are skipped (`[SKIP]`), the failed one is built again.

## Rebuild

```bash
wget -qO- https://github.com/nucbio/hpc-setup/raw/main/boot.sh | \
  FORCE_REBUILD="openssl zlib" bash
```

- `FORCE_REBUILD=all` rebuilds everything.
- Or delete the stamp: `rm .stamps/openssl-*.done`.
- `[STALE]`: the install script changed since the build. Not rebuilt unless forced.

## Update

Run the command again: packages with a new version are installed next to the old ones.
